meta.subject: fix barrier: warp_sche war_bar_exp record all wf in wg when first wf arrive; a simple testcase to verify

en.summary: This commit fixes a real barrier-tracking bug in the warp scheduler: the scheduler did not correctly initialize and update the expected workgroup membership for barriers, so multi-wavefront workgroups could synchronize incorrectly.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly describes a barrier bug and the intended fix.
The patch changes the warp scheduler's workgroup barrier masks and arrival tracking in pipeline RTL.
Incorrect barrier membership tracking is a classic SIMT control bug that can release or hold a barrier incorrectly.
evidence: warp_schedule.scala stops building warp_bar_exp incrementally from only currently arrived warps and instead initializes it from new_wg_wf_count when the first wavefront of a workgroup arrives.
The same file changes barrier arrival recording from physical wid to end_wf_id, i.e. the workgroup-local wavefront id recovered from the CTA tag.
warp_bar_lock is changed to depend on warp_bar_belong instead of warp_bar_exp, separating active membership from expected barrier arrivals.
The commit adds a barrier testcase under ventus/txt/temp_barrier_test to validate the scenario.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: The bug is incorrect barrier-membership bookkeeping in a SIMT scheduler. When the first wavefront of a workgroup reaches the system, the scheduler must know how many wavefronts belong to that workgroup and must record barrier arrivals using stable workgroup-local identities. If it only tracks currently allocated warps or uses transient physical warp IDs, the barrier can release too early, never release, or release the wrong set of wavefronts.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: workgroup barrier expected-arrival mask and arrival recording
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A workgroup spans multiple wavefronts and not all of them have reached the scheduler when the first one hits a barrier
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Restore barrier expectation tracking that records only already-present warps and/or records arrivals by physical scheduler warp id instead of workgroup-local wavefront id.
portability_notes: Map this to any SIMT scheduler that distinguishes physical warp slots from workgroup-local wavefront indices.
The portable core of the bug is using the wrong identifier domain for barrier tracking or failing to predeclare all expected arrivals.
This fault is most visible when a workgroup has more than one wavefront and the first wavefront reaches a barrier before the rest are all resident.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the barrier state that records expected participants for each workgroup.
Replace the preinitialized expected mask with incremental tracking based only on already dispatched/allocated warps.
Record barrier arrivals using physical warp slot IDs rather than the workgroup-local wavefront ID stored in the workgroup tag.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: warp scheduler barrier expected-mask and arrival bookkeeping per workgroup
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix initializes warp_bar_exp from the total workgroup wavefront count, records arrivals by end_wf_id, and separates active membership tracking from expected barrier participants.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore the older warp_bar_exp update that ORs in only io.warpReq.bits.wid on allocation, and restore barrier arrival recording with ctrl.wid instead of end_wf_id in warp_schedule.scala.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Multi-wavefront workgroups can pass a barrier too early, fail to release, or release the wrong set of wavefronts, leading to SIMT synchronization errors.
evidence_for_injection: The commit message states that warp_bar_exp must record all wavefronts in the workgroup when the first wavefront arrives.
The patch explicitly switches from physical wid-based tracking to workgroup-local end_wf_id-based tracking.
A dedicated barrier testcase was added in the same commit, which supports the synchronization interpretation.
notes: The CTA2warp edits are mostly explanatory, but they ground the meaning of the workgroup tag used by warp_schedule.scala.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 warp scheduler 中真实的 barrier 跟踪缺陷：调度器没有正确初始化和更新 barrier 所需的工作组成员集合，因此多 wavefront 的工作组可能发生错误同步。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确描述了 barrier 缺陷以及修复意图。
补丁修改了流水线 RTL 中 warp scheduler 的工作组 barrier mask 和到达跟踪逻辑。
错误的 barrier 成员跟踪是典型的 SIMT 控制缺陷，会导致 barrier 过早释放或永远不释放。
evidence: warp_schedule.scala 不再只根据当前已到达 warp 逐步构建 warp_bar_exp，而是在工作组第一个 wavefront 到达时根据 new_wg_wf_count 直接初始化。
同一文件把 barrier 到达记录从物理 wid 改为 end_wf_id，也就是从 CTA tag 恢复出的工作组内 wavefront id。
warp_bar_lock 改为依赖 warp_bar_belong 而不是 warp_bar_exp，把活跃成员与期望 barrier 到达者分离开。
提交新增了 ventus/txt/temp_barrier_test 下的 barrier testcase 来验证场景。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 该缺陷属于 SIMT 调度器中的 barrier 成员簿记错误。当工作组的第一个 wavefront 到达系统时，调度器就必须知道该工作组总共有多少个 wavefront，并且必须用稳定的“工作组内 wavefront 身份”去记录 barrier 到达情况。如果它只跟踪当前已经分配到的 warp，或者使用瞬时的物理 warp ID，那么 barrier 可能提前释放、永远不释放，或者释放错误的一组 wavefront。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 每个工作组的 barrier 期望到达 mask 与到达记录
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一个工作组包含多个 wavefront，并且当第一个 wavefront 到达 barrier 时，其余 wavefront 还没有全部到达调度器
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 恢复那种只记录已存在 warp 的 barrier 期望集合，或者继续用物理调度器 warp id 而不是工作组内 wavefront id 记录到达。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 恢复不完整的成员跟踪
portability_notes: 把该缺陷映射到任何同时区分“物理 warp slot”和“工作组内 wavefront 编号”的 SIMT 调度器。
其可移植核心是：barrier 跟踪使用了错误的 ID 域，或者没有提前声明所有期望到达者。
当工作组包含多个 wavefront 且第一个 wavefront 在其余 wavefront 全部驻留前就命中 barrier 时，该缺陷最明显。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位为每个工作组记录 barrier 期望参与者的状态。
把预初始化的期望 mask 改回成只基于已分派/已分配 warp 的增量式跟踪。
在 barrier 到达记录时使用物理 warp slot ID，而不是存放在工作组 tag 中的工作组内 wavefront ID。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: warp scheduler 中按工作组维护的 barrier 期望 mask 与到达簿记
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在工作组第一个 wavefront 到达时按总 wavefront 数初始化 warp_bar_exp，用 end_wf_id 记录到达，并把活跃成员跟踪与 barrier 期望参与者分离。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 恢复 warp_schedule.scala 中旧的 warp_bar_exp 更新方式：只在分配时 OR 入 io.warpReq.bits.wid；并把 barrier 到达记录从 end_wf_id 改回 ctrl.wid。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 多 wavefront 工作组可能过早通过 barrier、无法释放 barrier，或者释放错误的一组 wavefront，造成 SIMT 同步错误。
evidence_for_injection: 提交信息明确说 warp_bar_exp 在第一个 wavefront 到达时必须记录工作组中的所有 wavefront。
补丁显式从物理 wid 跟踪切换到工作组内 end_wf_id 跟踪。
同一提交新增了专门的 barrier 测试，支持这里的同步语义解释。
notes: CTA2warp 的改动主要是注释性与语义锚点，但它有助于说明 warp_schedule.scala 所使用的工作组 tag 含义。
